title: Rosh Hashanah
description: The Jewish New Year, a time of reflection, renewal, and sweet beginnings as we welcome a fresh start with hope and intention.

title: Yom Kippur
description: The Day of Atonement, our holiest day of spiritual cleansing, forgiveness, and reconnection with our highest purpose.

title: Sukkot
description: The Festival of Booths, celebrating gratitude, harvest, and the divine protection that surrounds us throughout life's journey.

title: Shemini Atzeret & Simchat Torah
description: Rejoicing with the Torah as we complete and begin anew the annual cycle of reading, celebrating our eternal connection to wisdom.

title: Chanukah
description: The Festival of Lights, eight nights of celebrating miracles, dedication, and the triumph of light over darkness.

title: Tu B'Shvat
description: The New Year of the Trees, honoring our connection to nature and celebrating renewal, growth, and environmental stewardship.

title: Purim
description: A joyous celebration of hidden miracles and divine providence, filled with costumes, storytelling, and community festivities.

title: Passover (Pesach)
description: The Festival of Freedom, commemorating liberation from bondage and celebrating the eternal journey toward spiritual and personal freedom.

title: Lag BaOmer
description: A day of celebration during the counting period, honoring learning, joy, and the light of wisdom that brightens our lives.

title: Shavuot
description: The Festival of Weeks, celebrating the giving of the Torah and our eternal commitment to wisdom, learning, and spiritual growth.
